naslov: Bucks and Raptors meet Friday in NBA Cup group stage
tekst:
Toronto Raptors (4-4, fifth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Milwaukee Bucks (1-7, 15th in the Eastern Conference)
              Milwaukee; Friday, 8 p.m. EST
              BOTTOM LINE: The Milwaukee Bucks play the Toronto Raptors in an NBA Cup in-season tournament group play matchup.
              Milwaukee finished 32-50 overall, 21-31 in Eastern Conference play and 19-22 at home during the 2025-26 season. The Bucks averaged 110.6 points per game while allowing opponents to score 116.8 last season.
              Toronto went 46-36 overall and 33-19 in Eastern Conference play during the 2025-26 season. The Raptors averaged 8.8 steals, 4.8 blocks and 12.9 turnovers per game last season.
              INJURIES: Bucks: Kam Jones: day to day (ankle).
              Raptors: Kawhi Leonard: out (knee), Nate Bittle: day to day (foot).
